claims.assertion: Mari describes moghyay as cat-sized, wingless, four-limbed, fruit-eating, warm-bodied animals native to some Temmer islands.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

claims.assertion: Mari says muon-based remote presence let her appear and sense herself on Temmer while her physical body remained aboard Toleka near Earth.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She describes the system as instantaneous and using full-sensory holographic projection.

claims.assertion: Mari says she represented ill Queen Alenym at an agricultural treaty signing with Mollusc Maya representatives, her first official government appearance as heir.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

coverage_gaps: Other details about the food contamination incident and the Second Contact project omitted
